# 4 bed bungalow for sale

> A residence of great character in a private setting close to Inniskeen/Carrickmacross and just 15 minutes from the M1 motorway. The property is easily accessible to Dundalk, Newry, the Cooley Peninsula and Slieve Gullion Forest Park. Approached through electric gates, this light-filled and spacious residence overlooks beautifully maintained gardens with an abundance of colour.

## Fakta
- Typ: bungalow
- Druh nabídky: sale
- Dispozice: 4 bed
- Plocha: 185 m²
- Energetická náročnost: C1
- Lokalita: Momoney, Inniskeen
- Cena: 525 000 €
